query: SELECT m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.matchScore, m.matchReason FROM meetings m JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id WHERE s.companyName LIKE '%Sapia%' AND m.isVisible = 1 ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
